note: Printed values of the 2017 core set's starting equipment and treasure cards (boss treasure left out), compiled from two independently maintained community card databases and checked against the card images in the official rulebooks where those are legible; see 41_rules_workshop.md, section 12, for the sources and the cards that rest on one source. req = strength, dexterity, intelligence, faith. Dice: b black, u blue, o orange.

Knight.heroic: Once per spark after making a block roll, the Knight may roll an additional blue die and add it to the roll.

Warrior.heroic: Once per spark during his activation, the Warrior may move one node without spending stamina. The next range 0 attack he makes costs 0 stamina and gains [node attack].

Assassin.heroic: Once per spark after making a successful dodge, the Assassin may attack the enemy he dodged. The attack does not cost Stamina but must have range to the enemy.

Herald.heroic: Once per spark during his activation, the Herald may use Perseverance. When he does, each character gains 2 Stamina.
